meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 把项目代码里的业务信息(业务领域、流程、步骤)提取出来,生成一张可交互的横向流程图,显示在仪表盘中。已有知识图谱就基于它生成,否则自动快速扫描代码。
howto.when: 对 Claude 发出 /understand-domain 命令时执行;有知识图谱就直接用它生成,没有就自动扫描,加 --full 可强制重新扫描。

say.text: 分析这个项目的业务领域,生成领域流程图。
say.note: 会先看有没有知识图谱,没有就扫描代码。

say.text: 用 --full 重新扫描并更新领域图。
say.note: 强制全新扫描,忽略已有知识图谱。

say.text: 基于现有的知识图谱生成这个项目的领域图。
say.note: 直接复用知识图谱,不扫描文件。

howto.what_en: Extracts domains, business flows, and process steps from a codebase and produces an interactive horizontal flow graph in the dashboard. Uses an existing knowledge graph if present, otherwise performs a lightweight scan.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /understand-domain. With an existing knowledge graph it derives from it without scanning; otherwise it does a lightweight scan. --full forces a fresh scan even when a graph exists.

say_en.text: Analyze this project's business domains and generate a domain flow graph.
say_en.note: Checks for an existing knowledge graph first; otherwise scans.

say_en.text: Re-scan with --full and update the domain graph.
say_en.note: Forces a fresh scan even if a knowledge graph exists.

say_en.text: Generate the domain graph from the existing /understand knowledge graph.
say_en.note: Derives from the graph without scanning files.
